bootstrap_notes: Compiler independently built with python3 -m tools.core --bootstrap test -n 2. First gate found an IR test that expected an inlined-away function to remain emitted. After updating that test to use a dynamic condition and inspect its caller, the complete gate passed with the same C-built compiler.
focused: 28 reachability, IR, web game and software raster checks; 12 integer/scalar select and reachability checks.
behavior: Release builds omit functions unreachable after inlining/folding. Roots include initializers, main, entry exit/flush, exports and transitive direct calls/function addresses. Watch/REPL and ordinary builds retain existing emission behavior.
output_bytes: Recorded by benchmark_compile.py outside timed intervals. Tour 192592 -> 181128; Dunes native 1779880 -> 1713568; Dunes HTML 1076474 -> 1043514; compiler 7227656 -> 7140632.
profile: Temporary instrumented compiler: pruning 2752 -> 2248 queued functions for compiler in 4.88ms; 1425 -> 1038 for Dunes in 0.94ms. These are instrumentation observations, not benchmark speedup claims.
limits: Native Dunes latency improved modestly; web recheck improved after a noisy first run. Compiler self-build regressed in paired measurements (1.039 first, 1.079 recheck). Keep as a size reduction with mixed latency, not a universal compiler speedup. Other CPU workloads were active. No generated-program runtime performance claim.
